response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_total, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, account_total, transaction_count, 1.0 * account_total / NULLIF(SUM(account_total) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM acct ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC LIMIT 10
